title: Boehringer Ingelheim and Zai Lab announce Collaboration on DLL3‑targeting T‑Cell Engager and ADC Combination in Small Cell Lung Cancer and Other Neuroendocrine Carcinomas
author: Na
description: Boehringer Ingelheim and Zai Lab announced a clinical collaboration to evaluate a dual DLL3-targeting combination therapy for small cell lung cancer (SCLC) and neuroendocrine carcinomas. The Phase Ib/II study will test obrixtamig, a DLL3/CD3 T-cell engager, combined with zocilurtatug pelitecan (zoci), a DLL3-targeting ADC. Both drugs have shown encouraging early efficacy and favorable safety profiles in previous trials.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Zai Lab's DLL3-targeting ADC (zoci) has demonstrated strong and durable responses with favorable safety profile, advancing into Phase III registrational studies. The collaboration with a major pharmaceutical company validates the drug candidate and provides additional development pathways in SCLC and NECs.

title: $207B Market Shift: The Race for Fast Track Approval in Oncology
author: Prnewswire
description: The FDA has accelerated oncology drug approvals with over 50 approvals in 2025 and increased expedited designations in 2026. Multiple biotech companies are advancing cancer treatments through Fast Track and Breakthrough Therapy designations, targeting high-unmet-need solid tumors. Key developments include Oncolytics' pelareorep showing significant survival benefits in colorectal cancer, Relay's zovegalisib receiving Breakthrough designation for breast cancer, MAIA's ateganosine advancing in lung cancer, Zai Lab's AUGTYRO approval in China, and Arrivent's firmonertinib entering pivotal Phase 3 trials for NSCLC.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Received FDA Fast Track Designation for pelareorep in colorectal cancer with strong clinical data showing 33% response rate vs 10% with standard care, 27-month median survival vs 11.2 months, and second Fast Track designation in gastrointestinal cancers. Expanding leadership team and targeting approval within 18-24 months.

Received FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation for zovegalisib in combination with fulvestrant for PIK3CA-mutant breast cancer. Designation supported by encouraging clinical evidence from ReDiscover trial with Phase 1/2 data presentation planned.

Secured FDA Fast Track designation for ateganosine in third-line NSCLC and initiated pivotal Phase 3 trial. Received $2.3 million NIH grant and established partnerships with Roche and BeOne Medicines. Clinical data shows efficacy above standard of care benchmarks.

Received China NMPA approval for AUGTYRO (repotrectinib) for NTRK-positive solid tumors, marking second indication in China. First approval spanning both TRK TKI-naïve and TKI-pretreated patients, addressing critical treatment gap.

Initiated global pivotal Phase 3 ALPACCA trial for firmonertinib in EGFR PACC mutant NSCLC. Prior FURTHER trial showed 16-month median progression-free survival and 68% response rate. Study designed to support accelerated and full approval pathways with ~42,000 patient addressable market.

author: Bamboo Works Benzinga Contributor
